title: Transfer, Adjacency, Confidence & Unknown-State Rules
objective: Define bounded visibility-safe advisory transfer eligibility, adjacency, confidence and unknown-state rules over completed KFR vocabulary, topology and explicit records without creating familiarity, competence, permission, qualification or canonical owner state.

resolved_contract.transfer_rule: A visible explicit KFR-04 rule may classify an advisory transfer candidate only when its source KFR-03 record and referenced KFR-02 relation are visible. Adjacency alone never creates eligibility or familiarity.
resolved_contract.unknown_rule: Explicit-unknown source records remain explicit unknown. Missing source records remain absent. Neither is rewritten into familiarity or competence.
resolved_contract.confidence_rule: Confidence is explicit categorical rule evidence, never a computed proficiency percentage. Incompatible confidence cannot become eligible.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized rules, source records and relation inputs are filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is not exposed.
resolved_contract.authority_rule: Canonical Character, Progression/Skill, owner-domain and Permission/visibility systems remain authoritative. KFR-04 produces advisory projections only and writes no target knowledge or progression state.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-04 persistence or duplicate transfer ledger is introduced; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.validation_rule: Exactly one current KFR-04 Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout. By explicit owner override on 2026-08-31, GitHub-hosted Linux, GitHub-hosted Windows and GitHub-hosted deterministic comparator are accepted as KFR-04 final proof because the required self-hosted selector remained queued without executing. This override is KFR-04-only and does not alter the project-wide default self-hosted final-gate policy.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-03 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
No automatic transfer, target familiarity record, competence grant, proficiency/certification/permission/ownership/action authority or operator qualification is authorized.
No canonical mutation, durable KFR-04 persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
KFR-05+, ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
